scope: v1 declared scenarios only; not all CompanyE business scenarios

checks.description: Tám khách sạn, bốn cơ sở mỗi hạng sao
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT stars FROM hotels GROUP BY stars HAVING count(*)=4) x
SELECT count(*) FROM rate_plans p JOIN hotels h USING(hotel_id) WHERE h.stars=3 AND p.breakfast_included=1

checks.description: Gói 3 sao không gồm buffet sáng
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM rate_plans p JOIN hotels h USING(hotel_id) WHERE h.stars=3 AND p.breakfast_included=0

checks.description: Quyền ăn sáng không dùng hết
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM breakfast_entitlements WHERE redeemed_covers<eligible_covers
SELECT count(*) FROM dining_orders WHERE meal='BREAKFAST'
SELECT count(*) FROM dining_orders WHERE booking_id IS NULL

checks.description: Khách dùng dịch vụ tại khách sạn khác
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dining_orders d JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) JOIN outlets o USING(outlet_id) WHERE b.hotel_id<>o.hotel_id
SELECT count(*) FROM bookings WHERE company_share_vnd>0 AND partner_share_vnd>0

checks.description: Khuyến mãi đối tác tài trợ toàn bộ
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM bookings WHERE company_share_vnd=0 AND partner_share_vnd>0
SELECT count(*) FROM bookings WHERE company_share_vnd>0 AND partner_share_vnd=0
SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b JOIN payments p USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='CANCELLED' AND p.event_type='REFUND'
SELECT count(*) FROM bookings WHERE status='NO_SHOW'
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT booking_id FROM booking_rooms GROUP BY booking_id HAVING count(*)>1) x

checks.description: Bán vé liên kết với khách sạn
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ticket_orders WHERE hotel_booking_ref IS NOT NULL

checks.description: Đóng hoạt động vì thời tiết
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM closures WHERE reason='WEATHER'
SELECT count(*) FROM tickets WHERE status='REFUNDED'
SELECT count(*) FROM vehicle_maintenance
SELECT count(*) FROM receipts r JOIN purchase_lines l USING(purchase_line_id) JOIN purchase_orders o USING(purchase_order_id) WHERE r.received_on>o.expected_on
SELECT count(*) FROM receipts WHERE rejected_qty>0
SELECT count(*) FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='WASTE'
